About.metaDescription: Why Online Na Ba? was built, how we check Philippine government websites, and our disclaimer.
About.title: About Online Na Ba?
About.lead: A free status page that shows whether Philippine government websites are up right now, and the best times to try them.
About.story1: Portals like Virtual Pag-IBIG are often down, or only accept registrations at certain times. People lose hours refreshing.
About.story2: We check these sites every 5 minutes and record the results. From that data you can see whether a site is up now, and which days and hours it is usually fastest and most reliable.
About.how1: Every 5 minutes we send one request to each site's public page and look at whether it answers, and how fast.
About.ruleSlow: Answered, but took more than 5 seconds, or said there were too many requests (429).
About.ruleDown: A server error (5xx), or no answer within 15 seconds.
About.note4xx: When a site refuses bots (for example, 403), we still count it as up: the server is alive, it just doesn't want automated requests.
About.noteIncident: An outage is recorded after 2 down checks in a row, and ends at the first check that answers.
About.noteUptime: Uptime is the percentage of checks that were up or slow.
About.gentleTitle: We go easy on government servers
About.gentle1: One request per site every 5 minutes, with no retries.
About.gentle2: We only read the response status. We never download the pages.
About.gentle3: We never log in, submit forms, register, or get around queues or time slots.
About.botNote: If you run one of these sites and have a question, or want checks stopped, please open an issue on GitHub.
About.faq1a: No. Online Na Ba? is not affiliated with any government agency.
About.faq2q: It says online here, but I can't get in. Why?
About.faq2a: We check the public page from a server in Singapore. Your experience can differ because of your internet connection, crowding on the login page, or parts of the site we don't check.
About.faq3q: Can I monitor my own website?
About.faq3a: Yes. Create a free account to monitor up to 3 websites and get an email when they go down.
About.faq4a: Individual checks are kept for 30 days. Hourly summaries are kept longer for the heatmap.
About.disclaimer: Online Na Ba? is an independent project. It is not owned, endorsed or operated by any Philippine government agency. Status comes from automated checks of public pages and may not match what you see. Always use official channels for transactions.
About.source: The source code is open on GitHub.
